+"""Tests for end-to-end marker gating."""
+
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize('qt_version, webengine, skipped', [
+    ('5.11', True, False),
+    ('5.12', True, True),
+    ('5.14', True, True),
+    ('5.15', True, False),
+    ('5.13', False, False),
+])
+def test_js_headers_marker_skips_only_broken_qt(monkeypatch, request,
+                                                  qt_version, webengine,
+                                                  skipped):
+    """Dynamic JS header scenarios run outside the QtWebEngine bug range."""
+    end2end_conftest = next(
+        module for module in request.config.pluginmanager.get_plugins()
+        if getattr(module, '__file__', None) is not None and
+        Path(module.__file__).resolve() == Path(__file__).with_name(
+            'conftest.py').resolve())
+
+    def version_check(minimum, compiled=False):
+        return tuple(map(int, qt_version.split('.'))) >= tuple(
+            map(int, minimum.split('.')))
+
+    monkeypatch.setattr(end2end_conftest.qtutils, 'version_check',
+                        version_check)
+
+    class Item:
+        def __init__(self):
+            self.added = []
+
+        def get_closest_marker(self, name):
+            if name == 'js_headers':
+                return pytest.mark.js_headers.mark
+            return None
+
+        def add_marker(self, marker):
+            self.added.append(marker)
+
+    item = Item()
+    end2end_conftest.pytest_collection_modifyitems(
+        SimpleNamespace(webengine=webengine), [item])
+    assert any(mark.mark.name == 'skipif' and mark.mark.args[0]
+               for mark in item.added) == skipped
